title: You Think Chromosomes Set Courtship Rules, Yet Brooding Pipefish Dads Flip Every Role
description:
You think male and female courtship rules never flip! But brooding pipefish dads turn picky while females compete! This is the true story of the Harvard care laws. Here is what went wrong with old courtship textbooks.
